AI Product Manager - Nimbus Health AI, Bengaluru
Full-time | Senior

Nimbus Health AI builds clinical documentation assistants powered by large language models.
We are hiring an AI Product Manager to own the roadmap for our LLM-powered features.

Responsibilities
- Own the product roadmap and strategy for generative AI features, from discovery to launch
- Translate customer and clinician problems into clear PRDs, user stories and success metrics
- Partner with ML engineers to define evaluation criteria for LLM quality, safety and latency
- Run A/B tests and analyse product analytics to prioritise the backlog
- Manage stakeholders across engineering, design, compliance and sales
- Define pricing and go-to-market plans with the commercial team

Requirements
- 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years on ML / AI products
- Hands-on understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and model evaluation
- Strong data skills: SQL and product analytics tools (Amplitude or Mixpanel)
- Experience writing PRDs and running Agile / Scrum delivery with Jira
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; MBA preferred

Preferred
- Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries (HIPAA)
- Python for prototyping
- Experience with Figma

Soft skills: stakeholder management, communication, leadership, structured problem solving.
